verdict.rationale: Svelte is a UI framework, and the evidence documents no rule-based automation feature that lets a user define event-triggered actions. The only related evidence is the `$effect` rune, which runs functions when reactive state changes. That is a developer building block for writing reactive code, not a rule/trigger automation capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: $effect executes functions when reactive state changes.
